construction_interface.author: Martina Lanini
construction_interface.title: Kazhdan-Lusztig combinatorics in the moment graph setting
construction_interface.checked_interface: Normalize the top stalk to the polynomial ring, quotient upper stalks by the edge label, and use the graded projective cover of the boundary image at each lower vertex.
construction_interface.degree_translation: This computation assigns degree one to linear roots.

reflection_order_shelling.author: M. J. Dyer
reflection_order_shelling.title: Hecke algebras and shellings of Bruhat intervals
reflection_order_shelling.checked_interface: Reflection orders induce EL-shellings. The opposite poset is covered by reversing the reflection order; inversion converts right labels to left labels.
reflection_order_shelling.application: In the rank-three eight-cycle interval, the first two atom blocks in a lexicographic shelling cannot be disjoint. Opposite last-two atoms would leave opposite first-two atoms, so neither opposite pair is a transported terminal set.

published_polynomial_baseline.author: Alexander Woo, appendix by Sara Billey and Jonathan Weed
published_polynomial_baseline.title: Permutations with Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomial P_id,w(q)=1+q^h
published_polynomial_baseline.locator: Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 1.2, printed page 2; Theorem 2.1, printed pages 5-6; Theorem A.1, printed page 27
hypotheses: Theorem 2.1 type I with y=z=1 gives the unique S4 singular interval [2143,4231].
Theorem 2.1 type IIA with y=z=0 gives the unique S4 singular interval [1324,3412].
The forbidden six-letter patterns in Theorem 1.1 cannot embed in an S4 permutation.
The unique 3412 embedding in 3412 has height 3-2=1. The permutation 4231 avoids 3412, so the convention gives height one.
published_polynomial_baseline.comparison: The computed stalk rank 1+q and full upward-kernel rank q^2+q^3 agree with these published polynomials and the paper's duality normalization. They are baseline confirmations, not new results.

scope.paper_baseline: The paper asserts freeness only for transported terminal upward-edge subsets and explicitly excludes a claim for arbitrary subsets.
scope.delivered_boundary: For [1324,3412], exactly the two opposite atom pairs give nonfree partial kernels, each with Hilbert numerator 3q^2-q^3. A second real BMP witness is supplied for [2143,4231].
scope.novelty: A fully explicit boundary to the proposed strengthening; no claim of priority in the literature.
